♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: With the Moon moving through Cancer in Pushya in your 4th house, your inner world is louder than your outer one. You may feel protective of your space, family, or emotional boundaries. The Sun in Leo in your 5th house keeps a creative fire burning, even if you’d rather work from a place of comfort today. Saturn in Pisces in your 12th can make you more aware of hidden fatigue or old worries; honour that by building in pauses instead of pushing nonstop.

💼 Career: Today favours work that allows some privacy or flexibility. If you can, prioritise tasks you can do from home or in a quieter corner of the office. Sun in the 5th gives you a spark for problem‑solving and design, but the Cancer Moon wants emotional safety before risk. Present ideas to trusted colleagues first, then refine them for a larger audience. Rahu in Pisces near Saturn in your 12th warns against letting office politics or unseen anxieties drain you—keep your focus on the work, not the whispers.

❤️ Love: The Cancer Moon in your 4th turns your attention to how safe you feel emotionally. If partnered, you may want more nurturing gestures—home‑cooked food, a cosy evening, or a sincere check‑in about how you’re really doing. Speak that need gently instead of waiting for your partner to guess. If single, you may feel less interested in chasing new connections and more drawn to healing family patterns or reflecting on what “home” in a relationship truly means.

💰 Money: Today’s transits lean toward practical, home‑related spending—repairs, comfort items, or tools that truly support your domestic life. Distinguish between emotional shopping and genuine investments in stability. Jupiter in Taurus in your 2nd house supports slow, steady financial growth when you respect your limits; impulsive risk for the sake of excitement is less favoured than incremental improvements.

🧘 Advice: Adjust your outer schedule to match your inner weather. You’ll accomplish more by working with your need for comfort than by pretending it isn’t there.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The way you care for your own heart today quietly resets what you’ll tolerate from the world tomorrow.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Cancer in Pushya lights up your 3rd house of communication, errands, and short journeys, making the day busy but potentially nourishing. Your ruler Venus in Virgo in your 5th house sharpens your eye for detail in creative or romantic matters—you’re selective, not scattered. The Leo Sun in your 4th pulls attention back to home and family, so you may feel like you’re constantly moving between calls and domestic concerns.

💼 Career: This is a solid day for planning, writing, and coordinating. The Moon in your 3rd makes you more receptive to information, while Venus in the 5th helps you refine presentations, pitches, or any work that involves aesthetics. You may juggle several small tasks; make a short, realistic list and cross them off one by one rather than multitasking endlessly. Conversations with siblings, colleagues, or neighbours can yield helpful leads about work or side projects.

❤️ Love: Venus in your 5th brings a gentle, discerning romantic tone. If you’re partnered, you may want to improve the small pleasures you share—better quality time, a more thoughtful date, or a shared hobby you can refine together. The Cancer Moon in the 3rd favours heartfelt messages; a sincere note or voice message may mean more than an elaborate gesture. If single, you could feel attracted to someone via daily interactions—commuting, local cafés, or classes—where their kindness and competence stand out more than loud charm.

💰 Money: With Jupiter in Taurus continuing to stabilise your 1st house, your approach to money is increasingly grounded. Today’s Moon supports negotiating, sending invoices, and following up on practical details. It’s a good day to review subscriptions, data plans, or commuting costs and adjust them to better fit your reality. Avoid agreeing to new financial commitments simply to keep others happy; your long‑term comfort must be part of the equation.

🧘 Advice: Let small, well‑handled conversations build your confidence. Every clear message you send today lightens your mental load.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The quality of your day hinges less on big decisions and more on how honestly you speak in the little ones.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: The Cancer Moon in Pushya passes through your 2nd house of resources, food, and values, making you more sensitive to questions of security and self‑worth. Your ruler Mercury in Virgo in your 4th house sharpens your practical thinking around home, family, and property. The Leo Sun in your 3rd keeps your schedule full of calls, messages, and movement, but underneath it all you’re quietly reassessing what really feels sustainable.

💼 Career: You’re detail‑oriented today, especially when it comes to logistics and documentation. Mercury in Virgo favours revising contracts, cleaning up files, or setting clearer procedures for how information flows. The 2nd‑house Moon may bring up concerns about whether your efforts are truly recognised. Rather than spiralling, pick one concrete step—updating your CV, adjusting your rates, or preparing for a future review. Practical, measured improvements have more impact now than dramatic declarations.

❤️ Love: Emotional security is a bigger theme than excitement. If partnered, shared meals, budgeting together, or calmly discussing future plans can feel more intimate than grand romance. The Cancer Moon can heighten defensiveness about criticism—watch your tone when finances or habits come up. If single, you could feel drawn to someone who seems dependable and emotionally warm; pay attention to whether you feel safe relaxing around them, not just entertained.

💰 Money: The Moon in your 2nd highlights both spending impulses and opportunities to strengthen your base. It’s a good day to check balances, schedule bill payments, and consider how your daily choices support (or undercut) your longer‑term goals. With Jupiter in Taurus in your 12th, hidden costs or forgotten subscriptions could be quietly draining you; a little digging now can free up resources without major sacrifice.

🧘 Advice: When you feel uneasy about money or recognition, ground yourself in one small, concrete action instead of chasing reassurance from others.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your peace today grows every time you choose practical clarity over anxious speculation.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Moon—your ruler—is in your own sign Cancer in Pushya, activating your 1st house and putting your moods and body at centre stage. You’re more intuitive, more reactive, and more aware of what nourishes or depletes you. The Leo Sun in your 2nd adds a focus on earning and self‑respect, while Mercury in Virgo in your 3rd helps you put feelings into words more precisely than usual.

💼 Career: With your 1st house lit, others register your presence strongly, whether you’re trying or not. This makes today useful for initiating conversations, presenting ideas, or setting boundaries—as long as you don’t speak from a passing emotional wave. Mercury in the 3rd supports clear emails, reports, and planning documents; take advantage of that to articulate needs around workloads, schedules, or pay. You may find that when you calmly state your limits, people are more receptive than you feared.

❤️ Love: You’re extra sensitive to how loved and seen you feel. If partnered, a small misunderstanding could feel bigger than it is; before reacting, ask yourself whether this is about today or an old pattern. The Pushya Moon favours nurturing exchanges—cooking together, gentle affection, or sharing reassuring words. If single, you might crave a connection that feels genuinely safe rather than simply exciting. It’s a good day to notice how your body reacts to people: tension is a message, not an inconvenience.

💰 Money: Sun in your 2nd keeps financial matters in focus this month, and today’s Moon in your sign ties them directly to your sense of identity. You may be prompted to consider whether your spending habits actually reflect your values, or if they’re compensating for emotional gaps. Practical actions—updating a budget, asking for a quote, or planning a savings target—give you back a sense of agency.

🧘 Advice: Give yourself permission to be “a little extra” tender today, but let Mercury help you translate feelings into thoughtful choices rather than reactions.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you treat your own needs as legitimate, the world around you slowly begins to follow that script.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Sun in your sign keeps you in a season of self‑definition, but today the Moon travels through Cancer in your 12th house, tilting you inward. You may feel both visible and oddly private at the same time. Old memories, dreams, or vague anxieties can surface, nudging you to retreat for a while. Mercury in Virgo in your 2nd brings a practical, grounded strand to your thinking about money and priorities.

💼 Career: Outwardly, you may still be carrying responsibilities and leadership roles, but today your best work happens quietly. The 12th‑house Moon favours drafting, researching, and tie‑ing up background tasks rather than bold public moves. Use Mercury’s precision in your 2nd house to review income streams, expenses, or pricing of your services. You might spot an inefficiency that’s been costing you time or money. If colleagues seem more demanding than usual, remember you’re allowed to say, “I’ll get back to you,” instead of answering instantly.

❤️ Love: You may crave more emotional privacy or alone‑time than your partner expects. Instead of disappearing, explain that you’re processing and that it’s not a rejection. Gentle, low‑pressure connection—sharing music, a walk, or simply resting together—supports you more than heavy talks. If single, you may feel drawn to introspect about past loves rather than chase new ones. This is productive if it helps you release guilt or idealisation and see what you actually want now.

💰 Money: With Mercury in Virgo in your 2nd, this is a practical day to sort out finances. Organise receipts, refine a budget, or double‑check standing orders. The introspective Moon in the 12th suggests that hidden costs—emotional or financial—may come into view. Ask yourself honestly where you overspend to maintain an image, and where smaller, more authentic choices would free you.

🧘 Advice: Let yourself step slightly out of the spotlight without labelling it as failure. Rest and behind‑the‑scenes repair are part of a sustainable path forward.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The strength you’re known for tomorrow is being quietly refuelled by what you choose to release today.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Cancer in Pushya activates your 11th house of networks, hopes, and larger communities, making you more attuned to group dynamics. Your ruler Mercury is strong in Virgo in your 1st house, giving you clarity, discernment, and a sharper voice than usual. At the same time, the Leo Sun in your 12th house shines a light on what has been operating behind the scenes in your psyche.

💼 Career: This is a fine day for strategic thinking about your role in teams or organisations. With the Moon in your 11th, interactions with colleagues, groups, or online communities are highlighted. Mercury in your sign supports articulating your ideas and boundaries with precision, but avoid nitpicking; focus on what genuinely improves the system. You might benefit from reconnecting with a mentor or ally who understands both your talents and your limits.

❤️ Love: Emotionally, you may be a little hard to read: part of you wants companionship, another part needs solitude to process. If you’re partnered, you could find balance by joining a social or community activity together, then carving out quiet time afterward. Conversations about shared future visions—where you want to live, how you want to contribute to the world—feel natural now. If single, you may meet interesting people through causes, networks, or friends of friends, but take your time; Mercury in your 1st urges you to observe consistency, not just first impressions.

💰 Money: Group‑related finances—shared subscriptions, membership fees, or collaborative ventures—may need attention. The Cancer Moon encourages you to prioritise arrangements that feel emotionally fair, not just legally neat. Mercury helps you analyse numbers carefully; it’s a good day to adjust contributions or cancel what no longer serves. Avoid lending more than you’re comfortable with simply to maintain harmony.

🧘 Advice: Use your current clarity to refine your commitments, not to judge yourself for past choices. You’re allowed to update your agreements as you evolve.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The communities that truly match you now are the ones where you can bring your full, honest mind to the table.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Cancer Moon in Pushya rises at the top of your chart in the 10th house, spotlighting career, reputation, and your sense of responsibility. Your ruler Venus in Virgo in your 12th house makes you more sensitive to unspoken dynamics and subtle undercurrents. The Leo Sun in your 11th connects your public role to your long‑term aspirations and social circles.

💼 Career: Today is one of those days when people notice what you do—and sometimes what you don’t do. The Moon in the 10th can bring emotional colour into professional interactions, so stay aware of tone. It’s a good day to show reliability: meeting a deadline, taking ownership of a task, or calmly handling something others are anxious about. Venus in the 12th suggests that part of your effort may be invisible; don’t be discouraged if praise is delayed. Document your contributions quietly for future reference.

❤️ Love: With so much focus on work and social obligations, personal relationships may need conscious attention. If you’re partnered, your schedule might be busy, but even a short, fully present conversation can reassure your bond. Be honest about stress instead of pretending everything is fine; vulnerability can strengthen trust. If single, you may feel attracted to someone connected to your professional or social networks, but Venus cautions you to check whether their values truly align with yours, not just their image.

💰 Money: Career‑related finances—salary discussions, client payments, or business expenses—come to the fore. The Cancer Moon encourages you to consider how your work choices affect your emotional security, not just income level. It may be time to set boundaries around unpaid labour or refine your rates to reflect the actual care and time you bring. Avoid comparing your path to that of peers; your measure of success is becoming more individual.

🧘 Advice: Let your desire to be respected guide you toward consistency rather than perfection. Showing up steadily counts more than dazzling people once.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Each practical step you take in public today quietly rewrites how you’re known—and how you see yourself.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Cancer in Pushya travels through your 9th house of wisdom, learning, and perspective, urging you to zoom out from everyday worries. Mars, your traditional ruler, in Gemini in your 8th keeps deeper psychological and financial matters active in the background. The Leo Sun in your 10th draws attention to your ambitions and life direction.

💼 Career: This is a strong day for big‑picture planning. The 9th‑house Moon supports studying, strategising, or exploring courses and certifications that can expand your professional reach. At the same time, Mars in the 8th keeps you alert to funding, power dynamics, and long‑term commitments. Combine the two: if you’re considering a professional upgrade, run the numbers and ask how it aligns with your deeper values. You may receive insight or advice from a mentor or experienced colleague; stay open.

❤️ Love: You’re inclined to seek meaning in relationships now. Casual or purely surface interactions may feel less satisfying. If partnered, conversations about beliefs, future plans, or shared adventures can bring you closer. A trip planning session or exploring something new together could refresh the connection. If single, you may be drawn to people from different cultures or with strong spiritual or philosophical interests; notice whether they respect your intensity rather than trying to soften it away.

💰 Money: Mars in your 8th means shared finances, debts, or partner’s income might be a background theme, but the Cancer Moon suggests handling them with calm realism rather than fear. It’s a helpful day to seek expert advice—a financial planner, accountant, or knowledgeable friend—about long‑term structures rather than quick fixes. Consider how your financial agreements support or limit your freedom to learn, travel, or grow.

🧘 Advice: When your mind starts circling around the same worry, deliberately expose it to a wider view—study, conversation, or contemplation can loosen its grip.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The choices you make from a higher perspective today have a way of untangling knots you couldn’t solve at ground level.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Cancer Moon in Pushya activates your 8th house of depth, shared resources, and inner transformation. Feelings may run strong beneath a relatively calm surface. Your ruler Jupiter in Taurus in the 6th house points you toward practical efforts in health and service, while the Leo Sun in your 9th reminds you of your larger vision.

💼 Career: Work themes blend the practical and the psychological. You might be dealing with budgets, confidential projects, or complex agreements that require both accuracy and sensitivity. The 8th‑house Moon favours researching behind the scenes, clarifying terms, and quietly cleaning up any messy arrangements. At the same time, the Leo Sun in your 9th urges you not to lose sight of your ideals; ensure that your commitments align with your ethical compass, not just convenience.

❤️ Love: Emotional honesty is highlighted. If partnered, this can be a powerful day to gently address topics like trust, shared responsibilities, or fears about the future—not as an interrogation, but as an attempt to understand each other more deeply. The mood can be intense; pace the conversation and allow humour in when needed. If single, you may feel drawn to people with a mysterious or complex aura, but take your time; look for signs of emotional maturity and reciprocity before diving in.

💰 Money: The 8th house rules shared assets, loans, and inheritances, so these may come to mind. It’s a good day to review joint accounts, check the status of debts, or clarify who is responsible for what in shared bills. Jupiter in the 6th reminds you that consistent, structured effort—like setting up automated payments or a realistic repayment plan—does more for your future than anxiety or avoidance.

🧘 Advice: When you sense emotional or financial entanglement, resist the urge to either run or control. Start by making one agreement clearer and let relief build from there.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The courage to look at what’s uncomfortable now becomes the freedom you feel a few steps down the road.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Cancer in Pushya moves through your 7th house of partnerships and open allies, turning your focus firmly toward “the other.” Saturn, your ruler, in Pisces in the 3rd has been slowly reshaping how you think and communicate, and today’s Moon makes the emotional impact of your words more evident. The Leo Sun in your 8th brings a spotlight to shared resources and deeper bonds.

💼 Career: Collaborations, client relations, and teamwork are in focus. The Cancer Moon in your 7th can make you more responsive to others’ moods—both a gift and a challenge. This is a good day to strengthen key professional relationships: check in, clarify expectations, or show empathy where someone is under pressure. At the same time, the Sun in your 8th asks you not to gloss over serious topics like contract terms or boundaries. You can be both kind and firm; Saturn in your 3rd supports clear, measured language.

❤️ Love: Relationship weather is heightened. If partnered, your sensitivity to your partner’s feelings increases, but so can your tendency to carry too much. Share the emotional load instead of silently absorbing it. Honest, heartfelt conversations about needs, fears, or practical matters like finances can deepen trust if approached gently. If single, you may find yourself reflecting on past partnerships and what kind of emotional climate you actually thrive in. Encounters today can act as mirrors, showing you how you show up in connection.

💰 Money: Joint finances, shared expenses, or long‑term commitments may be on your mind. The Moon in the 7th supports cooperative problem‑solving—work with, not against, partners or collaborators. The Leo Sun in your 8th can illuminate where financial arrangements feel unequal or unclear. Take a step toward transparency: bring up the topic, share information, or suggest a review, without insisting everything be fixed instantly.

🧘 Advice: Let your natural sense of responsibility be balanced by a willingness to ask for what you need in return. Mutuality is not a luxury; it’s part of your stability.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The agreements that truly support you now are the ones where care, effort, and influence are shared—not just assumed.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Cancer in Pushya moves through your 6th house of work routines, health habits, and daily service. It brings attention to how your emotional state and everyday patterns are intertwined. Saturn, your traditional ruler, in Pisces in the 2nd continues to highlight lessons around money and self‑worth. Meanwhile, the Leo Sun in your 7th throws light on important one‑to‑one relationships.

💼 Career: Today is ideal for improving the small systems that keep your life running. The Cancer Moon encourages a nurturing approach to productivity: organising your workspace, adjusting your schedule to your natural rhythms, or setting kinder expectations for what fits into a day. Work with colleagues can feel more emotionally charged; remember that everyone’s under their own pressures. Clarifying responsibilities step by step prevents resentment. The Sun in your 7th supports open, balanced conversations with bosses, clients, or partners.

❤️ Love: Relationships occupy mental space, but the real shift happens in your daily behaviour. If partnered, consider how you divide chores, handle shared logistics, and take care of each other’s wellbeing. Small, consistent gestures—making a meal, helping with a task, or adjusting a habit that stresses your partner—speak louder than speeches. If single, you may feel drawn to people you meet through work or service environments. Notice how they treat those around them; that’s as important as how they treat you.

💰 Money: Saturn in your 2nd keeps asking for sober, realistic handling of resources. Today’s Moon in the 6th suggests that the way you structure your days has a direct impact on your finances. Look at time leaks, energy drains, and inefficient habits; improving them can indirectly increase your capacity to earn or reduce unnecessary spending. Consider one small upgrade—a better system for tracking expenses, a more realistic work schedule—that supports long‑term stability.

🧘 Advice: Treat your body and daily environment as teammates, not obstacles. The more cooperative your habits are, the more room your mind has to innovate.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your freedom to live differently later is being built quietly in how you handle today’s simple, repeatable tasks.
pisces:
♓ Pisces

🔥 Energy: The Cancer Moon in Pushya activates your 5th house of creativity, children, and heartfelt expression, giving the day a more playful, emotionally rich tone. Jupiter, your traditional ruler, in Taurus in the 3rd supports learning, writing, and everyday curiosity. Saturn in your own sign continues its long lesson in boundaries and self‑definition, but today’s Moon softens that with warmth.

💼 Career: This is a favourable day to bring imagination into your work. The 5th‑house Moon helps ideas flow more easily—use it for brainstorming, content creation, design, or any task requiring a personal touch. Jupiter in the 3rd supports productive conversations, drafting proposals, or planning short courses and workshops. Rather than forcing yourself into rigid productivity, see what happens when you allow a bit of enjoyment into the process; you may get more done than on stricter days.

❤️ Love: Your romantic and affectionate side is lit up. If partnered, you may crave more fun and spontaneity together—playing a game, exploring a creative activity, or simply spending time in a way that feels less like “managing life” and more like sharing it. If single, this transit can increase both your charm and your desire to connect. You may attract people through artistic spaces, classes, or social gatherings. Let genuine shared joy be your guide more than scripted romance.

💰 Money: Finances are not under heavy strain from today’s sky, but your spending might tilt toward enjoyment—treats, entertainment, or children. There’s nothing wrong with that in moderation. Jupiter in the 3rd encourages investing in learning materials, tools for communication, or short trips that broaden your mind. Just stay mindful of Saturn in your sign: your future self will appreciate it if you put some structure around these impulses.

🧘 Advice: Let yourself follow what feels genuinely enlivening, but keep one foot on the ground. Inspiration and responsibility can cooperate more than you think.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you allow joy into the everyday without abandoning your limits, life starts to feel less like a test and more like a creation.
